method: Historical mechanical steelhead replay using Manistee River near Wellston, MI — below Tippy Dam USGS 04125550 daily mean discharge, Manistee River near Wellston, MI — measured water temperature USGS 04125550 daily mean measured water temperature, and three dynamic daylight segments built from UTC archive hours converted with historical local-time rules, using radiation, cloud cover, and precipitation. The read is scoped to Measured conditions describe the Wellston/Tippy tailwater and cannot be assumed throughout the long river below Tippy Dam. It validates scoring behavior and copy, not catch rates.
